18 assumed density cases below proposed64Nmm minimum; actual torque unmeasured
Measure real breakaway and running torque, locking, drift and wear
Actual fork stop bearing guide bolt preload and contact load sharing remain unsolved
Bounding boxes are compared; no carrying usability or optimized packing claim
Earlier finite reference screens are not exhaustive and require samples
Actual repeated-seating attenuation leakage response and ANC tests needed
Voluntary user feedback and measured pressure temperature humidity needed
Drop cycles cleaning ageing pinch and small-part retention require assembled samples
No model-specific mounting fit seal sound or comfort pass
Supplier quotes process capability tooling and actual assembly required

limits: Mesh and geometry passes are conditional numerical evidence, not a validated product
The volume-common kernel did not establish child Band identity; all six bands were therefore solved again
Friction hinge deliberately permits inward folding and does not lock every load direction
Threaded fasteners are envelopes; spring shown at a catalogue reference height; actual assembly requires calibration

meshes.assembly_method: CSR batches of up to2048 elements
limits: Separate linear elastic fork fixture; two full pivot bore surfaces fixed in all directions
Uniform 2N total X traction on cup pin bores; downward stop load chosen to balance moment about pivot
Not a full assembly contact solution; actual pin bearing pressure friction preload stop load sharing and support compliance are omitted
E2000MPa nu0.35 are assumed; no actual material strength creep drop fatigue child handling or comfort qualification
